name: Inutomo - Aka Inu Kanchi no Nichijou
original_name: イヌトモ 赤犬カンチの日常
source:
Kanchi continues his merry college life. One day he wakes up and gets a feeling that a trouble is bound to happen today...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
勘吉繼續著快樂的大學生活。某天醒來後，他產生了一種預感，覺得今天肯定會遇到麻煩……
